title: Host-Guided Crystal Structure Generation
description: Conditional generative models for placing atoms inside symmetrized host structures, combining diffusion-based inpainting with foundation potentials for materials discovery.

title: Generative Inpainting for Intercalation Materials
description: An SE(3)-equivariant score model that predicts intercalant positions in host crystals for energy-storage materials design.

title: DeepSTEM: AI Copilot for Electron Microscopy
description: Open-source tools for STEM image and EELS analysis, including denoising, atom localization, chemical characterization, and structure discovery.

title: AI-Assisted Chemical Mapping in Atomic-Resolution STEM
description: An end-to-end workflow for image restoration, atom localization, and intensity-based chemical assignment in complex two-dimensional materials.

title: Learning Local Structure in Monolayer Amorphous Carbon
description: Rotation-invariant representation learning for discovering interpretable local structural features in noisy atomic-resolution images.

title: Machine-Learning Denoising for Vibrational STEM-EELS
description: Machine-learning denoising for three-dimensional vibrational STEM-EELS spectrum-image data.

title: Data-Centric Structure Identification
description: Graph neural networks and feature engineering for accurate, efficient local crystal-structure identification in atomistic simulations.
